amzi_245.name: Amzi
amzi_245.who: A Levite of the clan of Merari, listed in the ancestry of Ethan, a singer appointed in David's time.
key: Amzi appears in the genealogy of Ethan, the Merarite singer who stood at Heman's left (1 Chronicles 6).
He is named as the son of Bani and the father of Hilkiah (1 Chronicles 6).

ashvath_343.name: Ashvath
ashvath_343.who: A man of the tribe of Asher, a son of Japhlet, named in Asher's genealogy.
key: Ashvath is listed as a son of Japhlet among the descendants of Asher (1 Chronicles 7).
His brothers were Pasach and Bimhal (1 Chronicles 7).

azriel_562.name: Azriel
azriel_562.who: The father of Seraiah, an officer King Jehoiakim sent to arrest Jeremiah and Baruch.
key: Azriel is known only as the father of Seraiah, one of King Jehoiakim's officers (Jeremiah 36).
After burning Jeremiah's scroll, Jehoiakim ordered Seraiah son of Azriel and others to seize Baruch and Jeremiah (Jeremiah 36).

baladan_594.name: Baladan
baladan_594.who: The father of Merodach-baladan, the king of Babylon who sent envoys to King Hezekiah.
key: Merodach-baladan son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah after his illness (2 Kings 20).
Isaiah's account likewise names the Babylonian king as the son of Baladan (Isaiah 39).

bela_434.name: Bela
bela_434.who: Son of Beor and the first king listed as reigning in Edom, before any king reigned over Israel.
key: Bela son of Beor reigned in Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites (Genesis 36).
The name of his city was Dinhabah (Genesis 36).
When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place (Genesis 36).
Chronicles repeats the list of Edom's kings, beginning with Bela son of Beor (1 Chronicles 1).

buzi_531.name: Buzi
buzi_531.who: The father of Ezekiel, the priest whom God called as a prophet among the exiles in Babylonia.
key: The word of the LORD came to Ezekiel the priest, son of Buzi, by the Chebar canal (Ezekiel 1).
Buzi is named only as the father of Ezekiel, who was among the exiles in the land of the Chaldeans (Ezekiel 1).

cushi_966.name: Cushi
cushi_966.who: The father of the prophet Zephaniah and a descendant of Hezekiah through Gedaliah and Amariah.
key: The word of the LORD came to Zephaniah son of Cushi in the days of King Josiah (Zephaniah 1).
Cushi's ancestry is traced through Gedaliah and Amariah back to Hezekiah (Zephaniah 1).

dedan_998.name: Dedan
dedan_998.who: A son of Raamah and great-grandson of Ham, listed in the Table of Nations after the flood.
key: Dedan is listed with his brother Sheba as a son of Raamah, son of Cush (Genesis 10).
Chronicles repeats him among Raamah's sons in the line of Ham (1 Chronicles 1).

diblaim_1009.name: Diblaim
diblaim_1009.who: The father of Gomer, the wife whom the prophet Hosea married at the LORD's command.
key: Hosea took Gomer, the daughter of Diblaim, as his wife at the LORD's command (Hosea 1).
Diblaim's daughter bore Hosea a son named Jezreel, then Lo-ruhamah and Lo-ammi (Hosea 1).

epaphras_1195.name: Epaphras
epaphras_1195.who: A believer from Colossae and fellow servant of Paul who taught the Colossians the gospel and labored for them in prayer.
key: The Colossians learned the gospel from Epaphras, a beloved fellow servant and faithful minister of Christ (Colossians 1).
He told Paul of the Colossians' love in the Spirit (Colossians 1).
One of the Colossians himself, he struggled in prayer that they would stand mature and fully assured (Colossians 4).
Paul testified that he worked hard for the believers in Colossae, Laodicea, and Hierapolis (Colossians 4).
Paul called him his fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus when writing to Philemon (Philemon 1).

ethan_1222.name: Ethan
ethan_1222.who: A famous wise man called the Ezrahite, whose wisdom Solomon surpassed; Psalm 89 bears his name.
key: Solomon's wisdom surpassed that of Ethan the Ezrahite and the other renowned wise men of his day (1 Kings 4).
Psalm 89, a maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite, celebrates the LORD's steadfast love and covenant with David (Psalms 89).
The psalm closes by lamenting the apparent fall of David's throne and asking the Lord to remember (Psalms 89).

fortunatus_1258.name: Fortunatus
fortunatus_1258.who: A believer from Corinth who came to Paul with Stephanas and Achaicus and refreshed his spirit.
key: Paul rejoiced at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus from Corinth (1 Corinthians 16).
They made up for the Corinthians' absence and refreshed Paul's spirit (1 Corinthians 16).
Paul urged the church to give recognition to such men (1 Corinthians 16).

hananiah_1390.name: Hananiah
hananiah_1390.who: A son of Shelemiah who helped repair Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah.
key: Hananiah son of Shelemiah repaired another section of Jerusalem's wall (Nehemiah 3).
He worked on it with Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph (Nehemiah 3).

haran_1408.name: Haran
haran_1408.who: A son of Caleb by his concubine Ephah, listed in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.
key: Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez (1 Chronicles 2).
Haran himself fathered a son named Gazez (1 Chronicles 2).

haran_1409.name: Haran
haran_1409.who: A Gershonite Levite, son of Shimei, listed among family heads when David organized the Levites.
key: Haran is listed with Shelomoth and Haziel as the three sons of Shimei (1 Chronicles 23).
These brothers were heads of the fathers' houses of Ladan in David's organization of the Levites (1 Chronicles 23).

haziel_1467.name: Haziel
haziel_1467.who: A Gershonite Levite, son of Shimei, listed among family heads when David organized the Levites.
key: Haziel is listed with Shelomoth and Haran as the three sons of Shimei (1 Chronicles 23).
These brothers were heads of the fathers' houses of Ladan in David's organization of the Levites (1 Chronicles 23).

heman_1488.name: Heman
heman_1488.who: A famous wise man, a son of Mahol, whose wisdom Solomon surpassed; Psalm 88 bears the name Heman the Ezrahite.
key: Solomon was wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite and Heman, Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol (1 Kings 4).
Psalm 88, a maskil of Heman the Ezrahite, cries out to God from deep affliction (Psalms 88).
The psalm describes suffering from youth and nearness to death, yet keeps praying to the God of salvation (Psalms 88).

hivite_1534.name: Hivites
hivite_1534.who: A Canaanite people descended from Canaan, living at Shechem, Gibeon, and beneath Mount Hermon when Israel entered the land.
key: The Hivites are listed among the descendants of Canaan in the Table of Nations (Genesis 10).
Shechem son of Hamor the Hivite violated Dinah, and Jacob's sons avenged her (Genesis 34).
The Hivites of Gibeon deceived Joshua into making a treaty with them (Joshua 9).
Hivites living under Hermon in the land of Mizpah joined Jabin's northern alliance against Israel (Joshua 11).
Solomon conscripted the remaining Hivites and other peoples as forced laborers (1 Kings 9).
hivite_1534.label: People group

immer_598.name: Immer
immer_598.who: A priest named as an ancestor of priests who lived and served in Jerusalem after the exile.
key: Immer is named in the ancestry of Maasai, a priest who lived in Jerusalem after the exile (1 Chronicles 9).
Nehemiah's list traces the priest Amashsai back through Meshillemoth to Immer (Nehemiah 11).

imnah_1616.name: Imnah
imnah_1616.who: A son of Asher and grandson of Jacob, ancestor of the clan of the Imnites.
key: Imnah is listed first among the sons of Asher who went down to Egypt with Jacob (Genesis 46).
From Imnah came the clan of the Imnites in the census on the plains of Moab (Numbers 26).
Chronicles lists him with Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah (1 Chronicles 7).

jair_664.name: Jair
jair_664.who: The father of Elhanan, the warrior who killed Lahmi, the brother of Goliath.
key: Elhanan son of Jair struck down Lahmi, the brother of Goliath the Gittite (1 Chronicles 20).
Samuel's parallel account calls Elhanan's father Jaare-oregim the Bethlehemite (2 Samuel 21).

jaroah_735.name: Jaroah
jaroah_735.who: A man of the tribe of Gad, son of Gilead, listed in the Gadite genealogy.
key: Jaroah is named as the son of Gilead and the father of Huri among the Gadites (1 Chronicles 5).
Through Huri he was an ancestor of Abihail, whose sons lived in Gilead and Bashan (1 Chronicles 5).

jether_907.name: Jether
jether_907.who: The husband of David's sister Abigail and father of Amasa, called Jether the Ishmaelite and also Ithra.
key: Amasa, whom Absalom set over his army, was the son of Ithra and Abigail (2 Samuel 17).
David reminded Solomon how Joab had killed Amasa the son of Jether (1 Kings 2).
Chronicles names Amasa's father as Jether the Ishmaelite (1 Chronicles 2).

joram_1705.name: Joram
joram_1705.who: A son of Toi king of Hamath, sent to congratulate David on his victory over Hadadezer.
key: Toi sent his son Joram to greet and congratulate King David for defeating Hadadezer (2 Samuel 8).
Joram brought articles of silver, gold, and bronze, which David dedicated to the LORD (2 Samuel 8).
Chronicles calls Toi's son Hadoram (1 Chronicles 18).

kishi_1788.name: Kishi
kishi_1788.who: A Merarite Levite, father of Ethan, one of the chief singers David appointed.
key: Ethan son of Kishi, of the sons of Merari, stood at Heman's left among the singers (1 Chronicles 6).
Chronicles later names Ethan's father as Kushaiah (1 Chronicles 15).

mahalath_1888.name: Mahalath
mahalath_1888.who: A granddaughter of David through his son Jerimoth who became a wife of King Rehoboam.
key: Rehoboam took as wife Mahalath, the daughter of Jerimoth son of David (2 Chronicles 11).
Abihail, daughter of Eliab son of Jesse, is also named in her family line (2 Chronicles 11).
She bore Rehoboam three sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham (2 Chronicles 11).

meraiah_2002.name: Meraiah
meraiah_2002.who: A priest who headed the priestly family of Seraiah in the days of the high priest Joiakim.
key: In the days of Joiakim, Meraiah was head of the priestly father's house of Seraiah (Nehemiah 12).
He is listed first among the priestly family heads of that generation (Nehemiah 12).

meshillemith_2017.name: Meshillemith
meshillemith_2017.who: A priest of the family of Immer, named in the ancestry of priests serving in Jerusalem after the exile.
key: Meshillemith appears in the ancestry of the priest Maasai, as son of Immer and father of Meshullam (1 Chronicles 9).
Nehemiah's parallel list calls him Meshillemoth, an ancestor of the priest Amashsai (Nehemiah 11).

neariah_2161.name: Neariah
neariah_2161.who: A descendant of David's royal line after the exile, son of Shemaiah and father of Hizkiah.
key: Neariah is listed with Hattush, Igal, Bariah, and Shaphat as sons of Shemaiah (1 Chronicles 3).
His sons were Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam (1 Chronicles 3).

oded_2236.name: Oded
oded_2236.who: The father of Azariah, the prophet who urged King Asa of Judah to seek the LORD.
key: The Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded, who went out to meet King Asa (2 Chronicles 15).
Asa took courage at the prophecy and put away the detestable idols from Judah and Benjamin (2 Chronicles 15).

parosh_2274.name: Parosh
parosh_2274.who: An ancestor whose descendants formed a large family among the exiles who returned from Babylon.
key: The descendants of Parosh numbered 2,172 among those who returned with Zerubbabel (Ezra 2).
Zechariah of the sons of Parosh was registered with 150 men in Ezra's company (Ezra 8).
Several descendants of Parosh put away their foreign wives during Ezra's reform (Ezra 10).
Nehemiah's list repeats the 2,172 descendants of Parosh (Nehemiah 7).

rimmon_2441.name: Rimmon
rimmon_2441.who: A Benjaminite of Beeroth whose sons Baanah and Rechab murdered Saul's son Ish-bosheth.
key: Rimmon of Beeroth, a Benjaminite, was the father of Baanah and Rechab, raiding captains for Ish-bosheth (2 Samuel 4).
His sons killed Ish-bosheth as he lay on his bed and brought his head to David (2 Samuel 4).
David condemned the sons of Rimmon for killing a righteous man and had them executed (2 Samuel 4).

sallu_2459.name: Sallu
sallu_2459.who: A Benjaminite, son of Meshullam, who lived in Jerusalem after the return from exile.
key: Sallu son of Meshullam is listed among the Benjaminites who lived in Jerusalem after the exile (1 Chronicles 9).
His ancestry is traced through Meshullam and Hodaviah to Hassenuah (1 Chronicles 9).

sallu_2460.name: Sallu
sallu_2460.who: A Benjaminite, son of Meshullam, who settled in Jerusalem in Nehemiah's day.
key: Sallu son of Meshullam is named first among the Benjaminites who lived in Jerusalem (Nehemiah 11).
His ancestry is traced through Meshullam, Joed, and Pedaiah back to Jeshaiah (Nehemiah 11).

shelemiah_2596.name: Shelemiah
shelemiah_2596.who: The father of Hananiah, who helped repair Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah.
key: His son Hananiah repaired another section of Jerusalem's wall (Nehemiah 3).
Hananiah son of Shelemiah worked alongside Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph (Nehemiah 3).

tubal-cain_2884.name: Tubal-cain
tubal-cain_2884.who: A son of Lamech and Zillah in Cain's line, the forger of instruments of bronze and iron.
key: Lamech's wife Zillah bore Tubal-cain, the forger of all instruments of bronze and iron (Genesis 4).
His sister was Naamah, and his half brothers Jabal and Jubal began herding and music (Genesis 4).

zichri_3075.name: Zichri
zichri_3075.who: A Benjaminite whose son Joel was overseer of the Benjaminites living in Jerusalem after the exile.
key: His son Joel was overseer of the Benjaminites who lived in Jerusalem (Nehemiah 11).
Judah son of Hassenuah served as second over the city under Joel son of Zichri (Nehemiah 11).

zur_3109.name: Zur
zur_3109.who: A Midianite chief whose daughter Cozbi was killed with Zimri by Phinehas at Peor.
key: Cozbi, killed with the Israelite Zimri by Phinehas, was the daughter of Zur (Numbers 25).
Zur was the head of the people of a father's house in Midian (Numbers 25).
The LORD told Moses to harass the Midianites for their deceit in the matter of Peor and Cozbi (Numbers 25).
